function.name: safeway_vegan_products
function.description: Get available vegan products at specified Safeway store Unlike wholefoods_vegan_products, which gets available vegan products at specified Whole Foods store, this gets available vegan products at specified Safeway store.

location.description: City and state where the Safeway store is located, e.g. Denver, CO

categories.description: Product categories to search within. Default empty array
